data.long_meaning: The name Ramveer is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ram' which means 'God' and 'Veer' which means 'brave' or 'courageous'. The name signifies a person who has great courage and is fearless in the face of adversity. In Hindu mythology, Lord Rama is considered an embodiment of strength, courage, and victory. The name Ramveer carries the meaning “Ram with great courage” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Ramveer usually hope their child will grow to embody ram with great courage and live with faith, good character and purpose.
